seo.title: Pricing | VoiceBridge
seo.description: VoiceBridge is free for families. See what is included, and the one-time fee for instant activation and full features.

hero.title: Simple, honest pricing
hero.intro: The core communication features are free for every family. A single one-time fee activates your account instantly and unlocks the full feature set.

free.title: Free
free.description: Core communication features at no cost.
features: Personalised communication board with visual cards
free.note: New accounts are reviewed and approved by our team, and activation can take a while. Want to start straight away? A one-time fee unlocks instant access and full features.
limitations: Needs manual activation by our team

instant.title: Instant Access
instant.description: Skip the review queue and start using VoiceBridge the moment you register.
instant.note: This fee also helps support VoiceBridge's ongoing development. See our Refunds & Cancellations policy for details.

items.question: Is VoiceBridge really free?
items.answer: Yes. The core communication features — the board, alerts and the mobile app — are free to use. Some features are reserved for accounts on the one-time ₹499 Instant Access fee, which also activates your account immediately instead of waiting for manual approval.

items.question: What happens if I don't pay the ₹499 fee?
items.answer: Your account waits for an administrator to review and activate it, and you stay on the Basic feature set. The one-time ₹499 fee activates the account straight away and unlocks the full features.

items.question: Will there be paid subscriptions in future?
items.answer: We may introduce optional premium features for therapy centers in the future. If we do, pricing and terms will be clearly listed here before launch.
